name: OpenFamily
short_desc: Family organizer: shared calendar, tasks and chores with kids rewards, shopping lists, meals, budget.
author: NexaFlowFrance
description: OpenFamily is a family organizer for your home server. It brings the whole household together in one app: a shared calendar, tasks and chores with a rewards system for kids, shopping lists, meal planning with a recipe book and recipe import, a family budget, a wall-mounted kiosk mode and an optional AI assistant. English and French interface.

form_fields.label: Allow new account registration
form_fields.hint: Leave enabled to create the first account, then disable if you want to lock the instance down.

form_fields.label: Public URL (needed for single sign-on)
form_fields.hint: The address you open OpenFamily at, e.g. https://family.example.org

form_fields.label: SSO issuer URL (OpenID Connect)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty to keep single sign-on off. Redirect URI to register at your provider: <public URL>/api/auth/oidc/callback

form_fields.label: SSO button label
form_fields.hint: Shown as "Continue with ..." on the sign-in page
